messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm proposing a SOFT deprecation for /metering/v1 -> /metering/v2. v2 enforces X-Route-Tag and normalizes session_id (fixes a common duplicate attribution case). Plan: shadow v1->v2 for 14 days, then 5% canary for 48h, then ramp. Any blockers?

ajay: SDKs will need a minor bump. can we accept both headers for a grace window? many customers still send legacy-tenant-id header.

sasha: Dashboard concern: invoice preview queries rely on route tags. If v2 normalizes tags we need preview parity during shadow. We should add a dashboard flag so previews can toggle between v1/v2 attribution.

dan-b: Telemetry notes — we should add a meter.ingest.trace_id and an ingest.sample_rate field so we can correlate mismatches. Also propose a reconciler metric: meter.recon.invoice_delta_percent.

kevin: +1 on trace_id. Billing needs a rollback plan if invoice deltas exceed threshold. Suggest: alert when invoice_delta_percent > 0.5% for >2 consecutive hourly ticks. If triggered, auto-revert routing for affected tenant buckets.

metering-bot: deploy:shadow-runner started for /metering/v2 at 6975313000, sample=100% shadow -> v2 (no writes to ledger).

maria: @ajay yes, accept legacy header for 30 days with a deprecation warning in responses. We'll emit a warning header: X-Deprecation-Warning: 'metering v1 will be removed in 30d'

ajay: will add compatibility flag to SDKs. question: route-tag format changes? v1 had freeform, v2 wants `tenant:<id>|team:<name>`. Backcompat layer ok?

sasha: prefer we canonicalize and store both forms for 14 days to allow dashboard joins. otherwise preview diffs will be noisy.

dan-b: canonicalization logic pseudo: 
```
// incoming
route_tag = normalize(route_tag) // lower, map aliases
trace_id = ctx.trace_id || gen_uuid()
emit(metric: 'meter.ingest.count', tags:{route_tag, normalized:true})
```

kevin: Important: reconcile job needs to run nightly during the shadow window and produce a per-tenant delta report. If any tenant shows >0.25% nightly delta we should hold off on canary for that tenant.

maria: rollout steps (short):
- Day 0: enable shadowing (100% read-shadow to v2, no ledger writes)
- Days 1-14: run nightly recon reports, surface top 10 tenants with delta in console
- After 14d: enable 5% canary write to v2 for safe tenants only for 48h
- If canary ok, 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 days with monitoring gates

ajay: gate checks? what metrics do we require?

dan-b: gate checklist: 
- meter.ingest.lat_p50/95/99 stable within 10%
- meter.recon.invoice_delta_percent < 0.25% (per-tenant)
- errors.prod.ingest_rate < 0.1%
- missing-route-tag count trending down

sasha: Also add a UX card in console: "Metering migration" showing per-tenant preview delta + a toggle to view v1 vs v2 attribution for invoices. Ops on call should be able to opt any tenant into rollback with one click.

ops-oncall: Add a runbook step: if invoice delta > 0.5% AND >$500 impact in 24h, page billing@ and flip routing for affected shard. Keep a kflag to revert quickly.

kevin: one more: backfill strategy for historical mismatch — if v2 changes attribution slightly we should not auto-adjust past invoices. instead tag suspected events and surface them in a reconciliation queue for manual credits. auto-crediting is risky.

maria: Agreed. We'll produce a reconciliation CSV and UI to approve credits. Manual only for now.

metering-bot: alert: nightly-reconciler job completed at 6975314500. top-deltas: tenant:acme 0.18%, tenant:fly 0.34%.

ajay: tenant:fly at 0.34% — we should hold that tenant out of canary until we fix tag aliasing. I'll open a PR for alias mapping and a migration script.

sasha: I'll wire the console card and add the preview toggle. ETA: 3 working days.

dan-b: I'll add the trace fields and the meter.recon.* metrics to the observability dashboard. Also adding a small sampling log that can be turned on per-tenant for deep dives.

kevin: I'll prepare a billing-side smoke test and validate ledger idempotency. Also adding a nightly job to compute invoice impact in dollars so ops thresholds are easier to reason about.

maria: Thanks everyone. follow-ups: @ajay PR for alias map, @sasha console card, @dan-b telemetry + recon metric, @kevin billing smoke tests. We'll reconvene after first night of recon reports.

ops-oncall: noted. tagging this thread for runbook and will add to oncall rotation notes. :thumbsup:
